summary: Iteration 5 — Dhara/MSafe Legal Aid: NEW pro-sample paywall + global non-dismissible disclaimer + swappable STT strategy. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest tests PASS (test_pro_samples_and_paywall.py, 84.9s). Verified: (1) POST /api/chat/stream mode='basic' × 3 → 200 SSE each, pro_samples_used stays at 0. (2) POST /api/chat/stream mode='pro' for non-Pro × 5 → 200 each, counter increments exactly 0→1→2→3→4→5 (increment happens only after save_assistant runs, we wait 2s post-stream). (3) 6th mode='pro' call → HTTP 402 with detail={paywall:true, reason:'pro_samples_exhausted', samples_used:5, samples_limit:5, pro_price_label:'₹50', pro_price_usd_label:'$5', message:'…'}. (4) After paywall, mode='basic' still succeeds and does not increment. (5) GET /api/auth/me returns pro_samples_used, pro_samples_limit=5, pro_samples_remaining. (6) Pro user (is_pro=true, flipped via mongosh) → 200 on 2 pro-mode calls with sample_consumed=false in session event, counter stays at 0. (7) GET /api/billing/pricing returns pro_price_label='₹50', pro_price_usd_label='$5', providers.stripe.amount_label='$5', providers.razorpay.amount_label='₹50', providers.razorpay.handle='calviltech', link_url='https://razorpay.me/@calviltech', features list ≥4. (8) GET /api/billing/razorpay/config returns handle='calviltech', link_url='https://razorpay.me/@calviltech', amount_label='₹50', amount_paise=5000. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, protest@gandhikar.in): login → chat-screen. mode-row testID present, defaults to 'Basic mode (unlimited)', pro-mode-switch testID visible. DisclaimerBanner (testID='global-disclaimer') is visually rendered on ALL 4 tabs (Ask, Rights, History, Settings) with the EXACT wording 'DHARA provides legal information, not legal advice. This does not create an advocate-client relationship. Verify with a qualified advocate before acting. © Callistus Moses · MSafe Solutions.' (Note: text_content() DOM read shows one extra leading glyph char \uf57b which is the shield-half Ionicons icon; the visible text and byte sequence after the icon match the required wording exactly — screenshot-verified). Old dismissible disclaimer-banner and dismiss-banner testIDs are ABSENT from the chat header. Pre-emptive paywall modal (testID='paywall-modal') opens when a non-Pro user with pro_samples_used=5 flips the pro-mode-switch ON; modal shows ₹50 / $5, Upgrade button (testID='paywall-upgrade-btn'), and Continue-in-Basic button (testID='paywall-continue-basic-btn'). Tapping Continue-in-Basic dismisses the modal. Upgrade screen (/upgrade) contains both '$5' and '₹50' strings. Test user has been reset to pro_samples_used=0, is_pro=false at end of run.
action_items: No blockers. Optional: consider giving the DisclaimerBanner container a data-testid for the wrapping <View> so it's introspectable while still keeping the leading Ionicons glyph outside its Text child if any downstream test insists on byte-exact text_content() equality (current implementation is fine for humans and for numberOfLines=4).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend pro-sample increment is correctly gated on `is_sample_consumption and content and not error` inside save_assistant — this matches the requirement that the counter only debits after the full stream completes with real content.
402 payload includes both INR (₹50) and USD ($5) labels so the RN paywall modal can display multi-currency without an extra fetch — good UX.

Frontend Chat screen uses a preemptive paywall on Switch onValueChange when remaining<=0 (before the send request) AND also handles res.status===402 during the send — double-defence, both paths verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pro_samples_and_paywall.py (new; replaces the stale /app/backend/tests/test_gandhikar_api.py which asserted ₹999 pricing and no pro-sample fields — old file was removed)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows verified visually and via testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates two fresh TEST_ users per session (one non-Pro used to consume 5 samples then hit paywall; one flipped to is_pro=true via mongosh to verify unlimited-no-counter). protest@gandhikar.in was toggled to pro_samples_used=5 for the UI paywall test and then reset to 0/is_pro=false at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration-5 requirements green. Backend paywall + sample-counter behaviour, updated pricing (₹50/$5), razorpay.me calviltech link, /auth/me new fields, DisclaimerBanner on all 4 tabs, paywall modal + Continue-in-Basic, Upgrade screen dual-provider — all verified. Only cosmetic note: DisclaimerBanner's leading Ionicons shield glyph shows up as \uf57b in DOM text_content(); if a future test requires byte-exact text equality, the Ionicon needs to be moved outside the <Text> child or the assertion should normalize/strip PUA chars. NativeSTT gracefully falls back to WhisperCloudSTT in web preview (verified in code path in /app/frontend/src/voice/stt.ts:214-222); actual on-device STT will require a native dev/EAS build.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The DOM-text 'mismatch' seen initially was a test-harness artefact (Ionicons private-use char included by text_content()), NOT a product defect. Visual rendering and byte content of the disclaimer wording are correct.
